env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
! logos run .
stderr 'union_member_no_json'

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/nodecoder

go 1.27

-- w/a/a.lgo --
package a

type B int

type C struct {
  R int64 `json:"r"`
}

type U interface {
  B | C
}

-- w/main.lgo --
package main

import (
  "encoding/json"
  "fmt"

  "example.com/nodecoder/a"
)

type Holder struct {
  Item a.U `json:"item"`
}

func main() {
  var h Holder
  err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"item":{"r":3}}`), &h)
  if err != nil {
    panic("nodecoder unmarshal: " + err.Error())
  }
  fmt.Printf("%T\n", h.Item)
}
